propositions: Empty file_impact field is overloaded: cannot distinguish author-forgot from no-file-impact, forcing conservative reads across all consumers.
Extend FILE_IMPACT event with file_impact_scope and no_file_impact_reason keys; derivation logic maps non-empty paths to 'paths', empty paths + scope='none' to 'none', otherwise to 'undeclared'.
Migrate set-file-impact from fixed-arity _REGISTRY to variadic _ARGV_REGISTRY to parse --none flag without silent failure; validate reason has ≥10 non-whitespace characters.
New library function get_file_impact_scope returns tri-state {kind, reason, paths} and MCP tool declare_no_file_impact writes no-file-impact declarations with same reason validation.
Transitions between undeclared/paths/none states must be mutually exclusive and reversible via last-writer-wins replacement in process_file_impact.
CLI, library, and MCP surfaces must all enforce reason validation and produce consistent state; rebar show must surface both new state keys.
